items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: We had a piano player with us then... That's Gabby(?).

ctx.x: Right. So on the way there we stopped in this gas station, I guess about ten miles out of Zanesville. And I had to get some gas. It was also a sub post office. Now, the only thing that saved us was that there was a little boy that had seen Gabby take the money. He drank the soda down, then he reached in the till and took out this bread -- unbeknownst to us, you know. But it looked like a set-up, you know.
